data.text/markdown:
Ideal vs lossy battery

Solves the same 24-hour dispatch twice, once with a StorageUnitIdeal and once with a StorageUnitLossy.
  • Load follows one sinusoidal day: l(t) = 1 + 0.3 sin(2 pi t / 24).
  • Both batteries start half full and must end half full.
  • Both use the same bus, power rating, capacity, and aging weight (0.01 $/MWh of throughput).
  • Every load can be shed at a linear penalty of 100 times the largest generator marginal cost
